GH #35 — `gh issue view 35` — full AC checklist (pages section, TDD chain, quality gates) 5. `~/workspace/src/routes/api/organizations/+server.ts` — the BFF you'll mock at the browser/fetch boundary in E2E + at the import boundary in component tests 6. `~/workspace/docs/architecture/bff-rights-aware-contracts.md` §5.1 — the response shape your fixtures must match 7. `~/workspace/src/routes/` — existing layout (if any) + auth route, so you know what's there vs new 8. `~/workspace/playwright.config.ts` + existing E2E specs in `tests/` if any — verify the Playwright setup is healthy first; if not, flag a [GAP] before writing new specs ### Scope of RED **E2E (Playwright, in `tests/`):** - Signed-out user visits `/` → sees "Sign in with Entu" CTA → CTA links to `/auth/login` - Signed-out user visits `/auth/login` → sees login page (Entu OAuth handoff) - Signed-in user visits `/` → orgs list renders (mocked BFF returns 3 orgs with `_thumbnail` populated) - Signed-in user with zero orgs → empty state visible - BFF returns 500 / network error → error state visible with retry button - Loading skeleton appears during fetch then resolves **Component / unit (Vitest, `*.spec.ts` colocated):** - Layout nav: shows "Sign in" link when no session; shows user-identifier + "Sign out" when signed in - Landing page (auth-aware split): renders the right branch given signed-in vs signed-out state - Org card component (if you split into one): renders photo / name / description / location / member_count_per_section; renders correctly when optionals missing ### Implementation-shape decisions to pin in tests (these become the contract for Byrd + Josquin) 1. **SSR vs client-side fetch.** Design preference is SSR via `+page.server.ts` `load()`. Pin in E2E by asserting page HTML contains org data on first render (no flash-of-empty). Component tests can be agnostic — pass data in as props. 2. **Auth detection mechanism.** Either `event.locals` carries a user object that the layout's `+layout.server.ts` exposes, OR cookie presence is checked client-side. Pin via `event.locals.entuJwt` since that's the existing CHORE-5 convention. 3. **Locale strings.** Pin EXPECTED string keys in tests (e.g., expect `m.landing_signed_out_cta()` returns the visible text). Use the locale path `$lib/paraglide/messages.js` per stack table. 4. **Photo render.** Pin that `` appears; src equals `_thumbnail` URL (60s pre-signed S3). When `photo` is `undefined`, fall back to a placeholder element (your call on shape — div with initials, generic icon, etc., but pin SOMETHING). 5. **Empty state vs error state distinction.** Tests should pin which copy + UI fires for empty array vs HTTP error. Don't conflate. ### Discipline - **Branch:** commit on `feat/frontend-scaffolding-mvp`, never main. `git branch --show-current` before each commit. - **Tests must FAIL** before handoff. `pnpm test` should show the new tests RED. - **Don't write implementation.** No `.svelte` files, no `+server.ts`, no `+page.server.ts`. In `src/tests/routes/landing/page.server.spec.ts` (your commit `c727f2f`), all 7 tests import from `'../../routes/+page.server.ts'`. Same `src/tests/routes/<...>` → `src/routes/<...>` translation; you just under-counted dots on this one.

Edit the 7 imports in `src/tests/routes/landing/page.server.spec.ts` from `'../../routes/+page.server.ts'` to `'../../../routes/+page.server.ts'`. Commit on `feat/frontend-scaffolding-mvp` with message like `test(#35): fix relative import path in landing spec`. Push.

This is clerical — no spec semantic shift, no new tests. Josquin is implementing GREEN in parallel against the unambiguous contract; your fix makes the spec actually resolve when his impl lands.

If Vitest currently shows 7 failures with "Failed to load url ../../routes/+page.server.ts" — that's the same defect; fix makes them turn GREEN as soon as Josquin's `+page.server.ts` lands.

[2026-05-22 14:19]

Adding one more clerical fix to the same patch you're already preparing for `src/tests/routes/landing/page.server.spec.ts`. Josquin spotted it during `pnpm check` after committing his GREEN impl at `62891be`.

### Fix #2: cast type

All 7 assertions in the spec cast `makeLoadEvent(...) as RequestEvent` and pass to `load()`. But SvelteKit's `load` parameter type is `ServerLoadEvent`, which is `RequestEvent` + `parent`, `depends`, `untrack`. So `pnpm check` REDs every call site with "missing required methods" type errors.

**Fix**: change `as RequestEvent` to either:
- `as Parameters<typeof load>[0]` (preferred — no extra import, self-adapts if SvelteKit's signature evolves)
- OR `as ServerLoadEvent` (requires importing from `@sveltejs/kit`)

Take your pick. Two character / line edits per call site, 7 occurrences.

The `Partial<RequestEvent>` return on your `makeLoadEvent` factory is fine — only the call-site cast needs changing.

### Bundle both fixes in one commit

Both clerical, no semantic shift. Suggested commit message: `test(#35): fix relative import path + load() argument cast in landing spec`. After your patch + Josquin's `62891be` are both on the branch, all 7 Vitest unit tests should turn GREEN without any impl changes.

No need to message me — just commit + push.
